guard: who lists agents with their presence metadata, hides infrastructure endpoints unless --all, keeps condition rows under --waiting, reports managed only from a manager's answer, a census it could not read as partial and a scoped answer as a label, refuses a roster it may not read, and whoami reports each grant state with a ledger elsewhere as partial
why: The suite drives the built binary, so each mutation rebuilds it and the restore rebuilds it back.
The managed decision and the user-auth grant states are imported from source in process, so those mutations are read without the build.
The remote-login cells drive the built binary with a real remote registration and cached login through the native auth provider. They do not invent an owner field the provider does not return.

The live roster-gap cells preload only a bounded KV-iterator fault into the real built CLI. They hold real replay entries or fail the real watcher; core computes presenceView and getRoster itself. No endpoint reply, presence state, clock or report result is supplied by the fixture.

Build the complete exact-source dependency closure first. All mutations in this config change only the CLI package; each mutant and restore rebuild that package instead of unchanged connectors and documentation.
